name: Chains of Shadow
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level antipaladin 3, lathspell 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (links of a chain, painted black)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a burst of shadow chains in a target point.

Creatures in the area that fail a Will save are dazed for 1 round and are entangled for the rest of the duration.

They can attempt to break free of the shadowy chains by making a Strength or Escape Artist check against a DC of 10 + your caster level, as a full-round action. If the target makes their Will save, or they escape the chains, they treat the area as difficult terrain.
